readings.title: The Cry Against Adversarial Deception
readings.subtitle: Calling upon YeHoVaH for deliverance from the destructive, treacherous tongues that mirror the adversary's nature.
readings.text: [Psalm 120:1] In my distress I cried to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And <dn>He</dn> answered me. [2] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, deliver my being from false lips, From a treacherous tongue. [3] What would one give to you, Or what would one do to you, O treacherous tongue? [4] Sharp arrows of a mighty man, With coals of the broom-wood!

readings.title: Dwelling Among Those Who Hate Peace
readings.subtitle: The psalmist laments physical existence among those who embrace systemic friction (Ra) instead of functional harmony (Tov).
readings.text: [5] Woe to me for I have sojourned in Mesheḵ, I have dwelt among the tents of Qĕḏar! [6] My being has dwelt too long With him who hates peace. [7] I am for peace; But when I speak, they are for fighting.

readings.title: The Unslumbering Guardian
readings.subtitle: Acknowledging YeHoVaH as the exclusive source of help, resting one's full weight (Emunah) upon His structural promises.
readings.text: [Psalm 121:1] I lift up my eyes to the hills; Where does my help come from? [2] My help comes from <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Maker of the heavens and earth. [3] <dn>He</dn> does not allow your foot to be moved; <dn>He</dn> who watches over you does not slumber. [4] See, <dn>He</dn> who is guarding Yisra’ĕl Neither slumbers nor sleeps.

readings.title: The Shade at the Right Hand
readings.subtitle: The promise of absolute physical and spiritual protection for those operating within the authorized covenant of Yisra’ĕl.
readings.text: [5] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is your guard; <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is your shade at your right hand. [6] The sun does not strike you by day, Nor the moon by night. [7] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> guards you from all evil; <dn>He</dn> guards your being. [8] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> guards your going out and your coming in Now and forever.

readings.title: Enduring the Scoffing of the Arrogant
readings.subtitle: Fixing our eyes upon YeHoVaH as servants to a master, awaiting His restorative justice amidst a world system built on pride and mockery.
readings.text: [Psalm 123:1] I shall lift up my eyes Unto <dn>You</dn> who dwell in the heavens. [2] See, as the eyes of servants Are toward the hand of their masters, As the eyes of a female servant Are toward the hand of her mistress, So are our eyes toward <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> our <dn>Elohim</dn>, Until <dn>He</dn> shows favour to us. [3] Show favour to us, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, show favour to us! For we are exceedingly filled with mockery. [4] Our being is exceedingly filled With the scoffing of those who are at ease, With the mockery of the proud.

readings.title: The Unshakeable Inheritance
readings.subtitle: Those who operate in Emunah are surrounded by YeHoVaH’s protective hedge, preventing the adversary’s legal authority from resting upon their allotted land.
readings.text: [Psalm 125:1] Those who trust in <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> Are like Mount Tsiyon – It is not shaken, it remains forever. [2] As the mountains surround Yerushalayim, So <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> surrounds <dn>His</dn> people, Now and forever. [3] For the sceptre of wrongness shall not rest On the land allotted to the righteous, Lest the righteous stretch forth their hands to unrighteousness.

readings.title: The Separation of the Upright and the Wicked
readings.subtitle: A petition for YeHoVaH's localized blessing upon the upright, while acknowledging the terminal annihilation awaiting those who choose the crooked paths.
readings.text: [4] Do good, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, to those who are good, And to those who are upright in their hearts. [5] But those who turn aside to their crooked ways, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall lead them away With <dn>את</dn> the workers of wickedness. Peace be upon Yisra’ĕl!

readings.title: The Premial Return from Captivity
readings.subtitle: Celebrating YeHoVaH’s restorative justice and mighty deeds that dismantle the adversary's penal system and restore Tsiyon.
readings.text: [Psalm 126:1] When <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> turns back <dn>את</dn> the captivity of Tsiyon, We shall be like dreamers. [2] Then our mouth shall be filled with laughter, And our tongue with singing, Then shall they say among the nations, “<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has done great deeds for them.” [3] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall do great deeds for us, We shall be glad.

readings.title: The Economics of the Joyful Harvest
readings.subtitle: The cosmic guarantee that those who sow seeds of obedience in tears will reap a massive surplus in YeHoVaH's restorative economy.
readings.text: [4] Turn back <dn>את</dn> our captivity, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Like the streams in the South. [5] Those sowing in tears, shall reap with songs of joy. [6] He who goes on and weeps, Bearing seed for sowing, Shall indeed come in with rejoicing, Bearing his sheaves.
